purpose.summary: Batch program that performs bulk printing of outpatient medical record cards (Karute card #1) for a given treatment month and department. It is part of the ORCA (JMA Standard Receipt Software) system used in Japanese medical institutions. The program initialises system parameters, reads patient and insurance combination data, and drives a print job via the ORCA print subsystem.

notable_features: No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — DB access is via CALL to ORCA middleware (MCP layer, MCPAREA/MCPDATA copybooks)
18 CALL statements to ORCA subsystem routines (ORCSJOB, ORCSDAY, etc.)
Extensive use of COPY for copybooks (.INC files): patient master, insurance combination, job control, print control, etc.
UNSTRING on COMMAND-PARAM for comma-delimited argument parsing
Japanese comments (Shift-JIS/EUC-JP, decoded as latin-1 producing mojibake)
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM PIC X(256) — invoked as a subprogram/command
No COMP-3 packed decimal fields visible in truncated source
verdict.notes: Source is truncated to first 16000 chars (~1/3 of the 46326-byte file). Japanese text in comments is garbled because the file is Shift-JIS or EUC-JP but was decoded as latin-1. The ORCA project is a well-known open-source Japanese medical receipt/clinic management system; this program (ORCBZ003) handles batch printing of outpatient chart cover sheets. The COPY count of 0 in mechanical indicators is likely because the copybook COPY statements use quoted filenames (e.g. COPY "CPSYSKANRI.INC") which the mechanical scanner may not have recognised.
